caption: A used coffee filter is knocked against the rim of a bin, and the puck of wet grounds drops out and breaks apart in the bin.

sa.check: A used coffee filter is knocked against the rim of a bin.
The puck of grounds drops out.
It breaks apart in the bin.
The knock comes first, then the drop, then the break-up.

pc.expect: The puck comes loose on the knock as one damp mass and breaks into clumps and crumbs as it lands.
pc.fail: It stays in the filter; or pours like liquid; or bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: It falls straight down into the bin.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or drifts sideways.

pc.expect: The knock frees the puck, and the filter is emptier afterward.
pc.fail: The puck falls before the knock; or the knock frees nothing; or the filter is still full after the puck lands.
It slides; or tips; or the puck moves after landing.

pc.expect: One filter and one bin keep their number.
pc.fail: The filter duplicates; or the puck vanishes in mid-air; or the bin turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The filter, the bin and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The filter changes colour; or the bin changes; or the kitchen rearranges.
